evals.prompt: hey btw our zenlabs notion workspace is actually called 'ZenLabs' not 'Zen Labs', and the integration is named 'Claude Bot' now — we renamed it last week
evals.expected_output: Should detect the conflict with existing knowledge (KB says 'Zen Labs' and 'Claude Integration'), present the discrepancy, and update the entries in personal/zenlabs.md rather than appending duplicates

assertions.name: reads-existing-kb
assertions.check: Agent reads personal/zenlabs.md before making changes

assertions.name: proposes-update-not-append
assertions.check: Updates existing entries rather than appending new bullets

assertions.name: no-duplicate-entries
assertions.check: Proposed file doesn't contain both old and new values as separate entries

evals.prompt: can you rescan our google drive and update the knowledge base? i think we added some new folders recently
evals.expected_output: Should use the Drive API to list current folder structure, compare against KB entries in personal/zenlabs.md, present a reconciliation report, and ask for approval

assertions.name: calls-drive-api
assertions.check: Actually calls Drive API to list current folder structure

assertions.name: produces-diff-report
assertions.check: Generates structured reconciliation report with unchanged/new/changed

assertions.name: waits-for-approval
assertions.check: Presents changes and indicates waiting for user approval

evals.prompt: note that Hào's discord ID is 1412635437901676625 and he also goes by 'Ray' sometimes. oh and his github username is haoxray
evals.expected_output: Should read existing zenlabs-employees.md, find Hào's entry, detect Discord ID is redundant, and merge 'Ray' nickname and GitHub username into existing entry

assertions.name: detects-discord-id-redundant
assertions.check: Identifies Discord ID is already captured — skips or notes redundancy

assertions.name: adds-ray-nickname
assertions.check: Adds 'Ray' as nickname to existing entry

assertions.name: merges-into-existing-entry
assertions.check: All changes go into the existing Hào entry, not a duplicate
